messages:
Priya (PM): FYI: scheduling a patch release v1.8.4 tonight 22:00 UTC to address a router memory regression. Need pin owner, one-line customer blurb, and rollback runway. cc @here :memo:

Ethan (Eng): propose canary 5% for 15m in us-east-1, monitor mem.rss and p99 latency. rollback if mem growth > 12% sustained 8m or errors > 1%.

Luca (Ops): +1. ops prefers start at 22:05 to allow last-minute smoke. rollback rules noted. will require oncall confirmation before promotion to 100%.

Rosa (Docs): I can draft internal + public. Public blurb: "Patch for memory regression, no API change." Internal will include triage steps and links.

Priya (PM): who takes the pin?

Ethan (Eng): Infra owns pin (Ethan). Rationale: touches allocator behavior; stability-first.

Avery (Oncall): Avery and Mei on watch. Runbook: http://go/runbooks/mem-regression. We'll post alerts to the oncall dashboard.

Ethan (Eng): deploy command below. will kick at 22:05 after smoke.

```
/deploy release/v1.8.4 --canary=5% --duration=15m --region=us-east-1
```

deploy-bot: queued deploy a1b2c3. scheduled start 22:05 UTC. monitors: system.mem.rss, redwood.runtime.p99, redwood.errors.rate.

deploy-bot: canary started 22:05 UTC. reporting window open.

Avery (Oncall): seeing mem RSS +9% at 7m, errors steady. Continuing to observe.

Ethan (Eng): I'll collect heap profiles from canary nodes. scaling not needed yet.

Avery (Oncall): at 10m mem growth hit 13% aggregate and one OOM on replica -> this meets rollback criteria mem_growth > 12% for 8m. issuing rollback now.

Avery (Oncall): /deploy abort a1b2c3 -> reverting to v1.8.2. tagging SRE for postmortem.

deploy-bot: abort processed at 22:18 UTC. live tag: v1.8.2. summary: mem_growth 13%, errors 0.4%. :warning:

Priya (PM): Rosa please hold RN draft. Update internal note: attempted patch rolled back due to mem growth on canary; no customer impact observed. Keep public blurb calm.

Rosa (Docs): drafting internal RN now: "Attempted rollout v1.8.4 (memory regression patch) flagged on canary and rolled back. Pin remains v1.8.2. Engineers collecting diagnostics; postmortem scheduled."

Ethan (Eng): pin owner confirmed. Next steps: reproduce with stress tests, add safety guard in allocator, then dark-test before reattempt. ETA after triage.

Luca (Ops): scheduling postmortem 09:30 UTC tomorrow. will attach heapdumps and logs. Change window will reopen after signoff.

Avery (Oncall): marking incident and notifying rotations. No customer alerts sent.

Priya (PM): thanks all. Rosa please post internal RN to #eng-all and cc infra/ops. Closing this thread after RN posted.

Rosa (Docs): posted RN at 23:05 UTC in #eng-all. Excerpt: "v1.8.4 attempted and rolled back due to memory growth on canary; no user impact; diagnostics underway."

Ethan (Eng): will follow up with triage notes.

deploy-bot: log: deploy a1b2c3 aborted and rolled back at 22:18 UTC. artifacts: ci/a1b2c3/build.log, ops/heapdump/a1b2c3/*.gz

Priya (PM): pin owner confirmed, RN posted, rollback decision recorded. closing thread.
